blocks.raw: <Tip>Remember: Liquidated damages = daily rate × delay days = fixed compensation. Enforceable if reasonable, not unconscionable. Accrues automatically from day of delay until Substantial Completion. Court can reduce iniquitous amounts. Contractor can avoid if it proves delay was not its fault.</Tip>
